title: Finite locally projective condensed coefficient module
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-ring-object], $X$ a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and $L$ a module sheaf over $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. Use the sizes of [def-weil-size-convention] and the canonical module inverse image of [det-lem-formal-closed-support-adjunction]. Say that $L$ is finite locally projective if every object $V$ of $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ has a covering sieve $R$ such that, for each arrow $W\to V$ in $R$, the restriction of $L$ to $W_{\mathrm{proet}}$ is a retract of $\Lambda_W^{\oplus r}$ for some finite integer $r\geq0$. Explicitly there are module maps $\iota:L|_W\to\Lambda_W^{\oplus r}$ and $\pi:\Lambda_W^{\oplus r}\to L|_W$ with $\pi\iota=1$. The rank may vary with $W$.
